proposals.before: That day he was indeed beaten by the Jin and the Zhen and Ding armies; a dozen commanders were taken and the rest broke and ran.
proposals.after: That day the northern force was indeed beaten by the Jin and the Zhen and Ding armies; a dozen commanders were taken and the rest broke and ran.
proposals.reason: Chinese has no personal subject; the defeat continues the northern campaign force context (Wang Jingren), not the Emperor personally.

proposals.before: Gao Wanxing of Yanzhou reported that Gao Wanjin, army commander, took Yanzhou on the fifth of the month; the puppet prefect Gao Xingcun came in bonds to surrender.
proposals.after: Gao Wanxing of Yanzhou reported that Gao Wanjin, army commander, took Salt Prefecture (鹽州) on the fifth of the month; the puppet prefect Gao Xingcun came in bonds to surrender.
proposals.reason: Source 收鹽州 is Salt Prefecture (鹽州), distinct from Gao Wanxing's seat 延州; the idiomatic English wrongly uses Yanzhou for both.

decisions.after: That day the army was indeed beaten by the Jin and the Zhen and Ding armies; a dozen commanders were taken and the rest broke and ran.
decisions.reason: Focus 是日，果為晉軍及鎮、定之師所敗 has no personal subject, and 都將…餘眾奔潰 describes an army rout, so idiomatic 'he' wrongly attaches the defeat to the Emperor of s0043. The proposed 'northern force' invents a geographic label absent from this unit and the supplied window; render the omitted subject as 'the army', matching s0042 兵可憂矣.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 是日，果為晉軍及鎮、定之師所敗，都將十餘人被擒，餘眾奔潰

decisions.reason: Focus 今月五日收鹽州 names Salt Prefecture (鹽州), distinct from the reporter's seat 延州節度使. Idiomatic English wrongly reused Yanzhou for both; Salt Prefecture (鹽州) restores the captured place.
